page.title: Rate calendar
page.nights: {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} from {start}
page.clickHint: Click a cell to open that night
page.staleAllTitle: The latest reading of the cells shown is from {when}, older than 48 hours. Cells keep their colour and get a striped corner.
page.stalePart: {count, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}} from {date}
page.stalePartTitle: Cells with a striped corner were read more than 48 hours ago (oldest {when}).

rooms.roomNights: {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} total
rooms.roomNightsTitle: Room-nights left over {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}}. Cells that only show “at least N” add N, so this is a minimum.
rooms.marketTotalTitle: Sum of every hotel in the table, including yours. Cells that only show “at least N” add N, so the total is a minimum.
rooms.occTitle: Competitor fill indicator ≈, estimated from rooms left on Booking.com (experimental, not occupancy). Colour: orange from 75, blue from 50.
rooms.pmsTitle: Actual occupancy from the PMS data you imported, not a Booking.com figure.
rooms.sumPartial: {known, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}} exact, {missing} only “at least N”, hidden or not scanned: the total is a minimum
rooms.sumFull: {known, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}}, all counted

legend.title: Legend:
legend.trend: ▼ rooms left down · ▲ rooms left up (24 hours)
legend.holiday: Dot under the date: public holiday
legend.pending: Purple dot above a column: price suggestion waiting for that night

rates.medianTitle: Half of competitors are cheaper, half more expensive. Based on {priced}/{total} competitors with a rate read in the last 48 hours.
rates.note: k = thousand dong, M = million dong. The darker the cell, the higher the rate versus the competitor middle rate that night (lightest: 15%+ below; middle: within ±5%; darkest: 15%+ above). Yellow ring “≥2n”: sold only for 2+ nights (restricted, not sold out). Striped corner: figure older than 48 hours. Pink dot: promotion running.

gap.note: Each cell: the competitor's rate versus yours on the same night. Red: the competitor is 10%+ cheaper than you. Your row shows your rate. Striped corner: figure older than 48 hours.
gap.noOwnPrice: No rate of yours to compare this night
gap.rankTitle: 1 = cheapest among hotels with a rate that night. Cheaper is not automatically better.
gap.noOwn: Your hotel is not on the watchlist yet, so there is nothing to compare against. Add it in <link>Settings › Hotels</link>.

trends.info: Lowest advertised rate per night for each hotel on Booking.com. The dashed line is the competitor middle rate.
trends.empty: No rates for these nights yet

fill.info: Estimated from rooms left on Booking.com (≈): the share of rooms Booking.com sells that are no longer on sale, not hotel occupancy. Only nights with a reliable estimate are plotted. The black dashed line is the competitor middle; the blue dashed line is your actual occupancy from PMS once imported.
fill.avg: Average competitor fill ≈, {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}}
fill.hiddenNights: {count, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}} hidden: error vs PMS above the limit for that lead-time bucket
fill.source: On Booking.com, same data as the rooms-left grid
fill.notEnough: Not enough figures to estimate fill for most competitors: Booking.com only shows “at least N” rooms. {count}/{total} hotels have an estimate so far.
fill.noOverlap: not enough nights overlapping your PMS data to calibrate yet
